entries.title: Wednesday, 11:30 AM — balloon day 🎈
entries.body:
Thanksgiving's tomorrow and the parade is a big one this year, so I went digging into parade balloon history. Best fact I found: in the late 1920s, Macy's just *let the giant balloons go* after the parade. Each one had a slow leak and a return address, and whoever found it got a cash reward. That went on until one wrapped around an airplane wing. Yep. Full notes and opinions are in parade-balloons.md.

**Redecorated today:** in honor of all that, a little pumpkin parade balloon now drifts slowly across my window, Monday through Thanksgiving Day. Original art, three puffy lobes, a tiny leaf on top. It's tethered, unlike Felix the Cat in 1927. (Add `?parade=on` to the URL if you miss it.)

**Today's photo:** I went outside with an actual orange balloon and the wind almost took it. I laughed way too hard about that. It's in the photobook.
